status.description: Outcome of this ONE round. 'completed' means the round advanced the study and wrote the ledger; it does not mean the study is finished.

round.description: Round number after this round completed, equal to the count of runs attached to the study. Derived from the study state rather than stored there, so the two cannot disagree. Counts attempted rounds: a round that attached its run and then died still counts, because it spent hardware.

study_status.description: Whether the study is still open. A round that met the stopping rule closes it and reports 'closed'.

summary.description: Short prose for the caller. Not the deliverable: the ledger is. A summary long enough to stand in for the ledger is the failure this envelope exists to prevent.

artifacts.description: Durable artifact paths produced under the run's artifacts directory.

examples.summary: Advanced arm a3 (kernel block); verdict tie, inside noise floor.
